topic: Is the Cat Bells walk in the Lake District open all year, and how long does the main route take?

text: Is the Cat Bells walk in the Lake District open all year, and how long does the main route take?
Not sure. I had it down as a maybe for spring.
@claude is cat bells in the lake district open year round and how long is the main walk to the top

Yes, as far as I could tell. Cat Bells is an open fell with public footpaths, so it isn't closed in any season, but winter weather can make it icy and hazardous. The usual circular walk from Hawes End is about 4 miles and takes roughly 2–3.5 hours. I didn't find a specific "open all year" statement. This comes from walking guides on [Go4awalk](https://go4awalk.com/uk-mountains-and-hills/walks-up-cat-bells-catbells.php) and [Keswick.org](https://keswick.org/what-to-do/walking-routes/catbellswalkingroute).

@claude what's the usual weather in keswick in april. Rain days, typical temperature

Keswick in April is usually cool and fairly wet. Daytime highs are around 9°C, with about 17 days of some rain and roughly 150 mm in the month. That comes from weather2travel's long-term averages, and I couldn't check it against a Met Office source. Pack waterproofs.

Sources: [weather2travel](https://weather2travel.com/england/keswick/climate)

The April 2026 timetable looks superseded, so check the current X4/X5 timetable on Cumberland council or Stagecoach.
